reason: Rank the TB conversion path first: it is relevant to n=512 and has a concrete verified mapping, though its timed A transpose and packing costs leave the net effect unknown. assembly_audit proposes the same TB experiment, so it is a duplicate and should abstain if n512_fast_path is tested. panel_packing is a distinct TB layout with a full B conversion, which adds cost and correctness risk. The 320-byte scratch stride is a concrete, distinct cache hypothesis, but its 160 KiB footprint exceeds the supplied 128 KiB P-core L1D and cache indexing is unknown. TA and TT require one and two full input transposes, respectively. The fused transpose proposal lacks a supplied legal instruction sequence and risks repeated work or changed arithmetic order. The store-order proposal changes only extraction and stores; the evidence gives little reason to expect benefit. No proposal has measured evidence of a speedup, and noisy historical scores do not establish causality.
